overview.description: The MicroSectors 3x Long MANGOS+ ex Private Companies ETNs (MNGU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the NYSE MaNGoS+ index. The fund provides 3x the daily price movements of an index of 10 US-listed companies perceived to be at the center of the artificial intelligence economy. The index is highly concentrated and equally weighted. MNGU was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by MicroSectors.
